facts.name: Carol Falvey
facts.assignment: Citrus administrative judge; profile lists all general civil cases and family assignments with differing scope language retained below.

contact.contact_note: Guide and profile scheduling paragraph use Ada Nieves Muller; profile contact block and roster use Ada Nieves. Phone is shared office/assistant route; no distinct personal judicial email or separate assistant telephone established.

chambers_communications.summary: Use the assistant/office route. Profile prohibits direct discussion of pending cases with the judge; improper merits communications are not forwarded.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Profile: OnceHub for one hour or less, choose three options, coordinate with opposing counsel and file the motion first; telephone inquiries for more than one hour. Guide: confirm coordinated time with the office before preparing notice and email the notice to the assistant. Times are not held; cross-noticing needs office approval.

conferral_and_motions.summary: Coordinate hearing availability with counsel; unilaterally set hearings are generally not scheduled. Motion-specific discovery and limine instructions remain in the official guide, outside this operating summary.

proposed_orders.summary: Guide: email assistant if all parties have counsel; if any party is pro se, submit conforming copies and self-addressed stamped envelopes by mail or hand delivery. Include certificate of service naming counsel/parties. Profile separately directs final judgments through the e-Portal; source-specific routes retained.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email notice of hearing. Guide allows case law under five pages by email or mail and directs submissions over five pages by mail with sufficient review time; exactly five pages is not addressed.

remote_appearances.summary: Profile: requested Zoom hearing generates link for the notice. Guide: arrange telephone appearance through assistant without motion/order; personal appearances required for pretrial conferences and trials. These are separate stated routes, not blanket remote permission.

cancellations.summary: File cancellation and immediately notify office by phone/email; only scheduling party or court may cancel. Cross-noticing requires approval.

facts.summary: Civil hearings use coordinated scheduling, OnceHub for shorter settings and assistant contact for longer settings. Preserve the guide’s representation-dependent proposed-order route, courtesy-copy limits and stated remote/in-person distinctions.

stated_dates.date_note: No express revision/effective date in reviewed text. The 2026/06 URL and 2026 filename are source identifiers, not inferred legal dates.

review_scope.not_reviewed: Detailed discovery/protective-order and privilege-log provisions, p4 motion-in-limine litigation recipe, linked medical-examination guidelines and booking transactions. No cases/dockets researched.
